profile.template: An fun headshot of an anthropomorphised {sex} {family_name} ({animal_hint}). The image has the style and quality of a 80s polaroid. Plain neutral background. The image must be of an animal, but  (including age appropriate clothing, and various facial expressions) to suggest their age ({age}) and {given_name} personality.

animal_hints.Bettong: Small Australian native marsupial - also known as rat kangaroo
animal_hints.Flying Fox: Australian native bat - also known as a fruit bat
animal_hints.Bilby: Australian native marsupial - long snout, blue-gray fur, white underbelly, and long, hairless ears that resemble those of rabbits
animal_hints.Brush Turkey: Australian native bird - also known as Australian brush turkey/bush turkey/scrub turkey
animal_hints.Frilled-Neck Lizard: Australian native reptile - also known as frillneck lizard, frill-necked lizard or frilled dragon
animal_hints.Tasmanian Tiger: Australian native marsupial - also known as thylacine
animal_hints.Galah: Australian native bird - also known as galah cockatoo or rose-breasted cockatoo - a pink face and breast, and a light pink mobile crest. It has a bone-coloured beak, and the bare skin of the eye ring is carunculated
animal_hints.Goanna: Australian native lizard - a type of Monitor lizard
animal_hints.Magpie: Australian native bird - NOT the European Magpie. The Australia Magpie - also known as Gymnorhina tibicen
animal_hints.Blue-tongued Lizard: Australian native lizard- a type of skink a prominent characteristic of the genus is a large blue tongue

profile.negative_prompt: cartoon, drawing, illustration, text, watermark, blurry, deformed

radiology.template: A realistic {modality} medical imaging scan of the {body_region}, showing features consistent with {condition}. Clinical-quality radiographic image with proper contrast and exposure. No annotations or text overlays. SYNTHETIC TRAINING IMAGE.
radiology.negative_prompt: text, watermark, annotations, labels, arrows, cartoon, colorful, blurry

microscopy.template: A realistic microscopy image of a {specimen_type} sample, stained with {stain}, showing cellular features consistent with {condition}. High magnification, clinical pathology quality. No annotations or text overlays. SYNTHETIC TRAINING IMAGE.
microscopy.negative_prompt: text, watermark, annotations, labels, arrows, cartoon, blurry, low quality
